title: Jammu: Police detains social activist, some demonstrators during PSI exam protests

ai.summary: Police detained social activist Deepika Singh Rajawat during protests in Jammu demanding postponement of the JKPSI exam and investigation into alleged irregularities in the FAA recruitment exam.

facts.claim: Police detained social activist Deepika Singh Rajawat
facts.quote: As Deepika was leading the protests by government job aspirants and youth, she challenged the police to arrest her. As the situation continued, police detained Deepika along with a few others.

facts.claim: Protests demanded postponement of the JKPSI exam
facts.quote: Jammu and Kashmir Police Sub-Inspector (JKPSI) examination

facts.claim: Protests demanded investigation into alleged irregularities in FAA recruitment exam
facts.quote: the government job aspirants were also demanding a thorough investigation into the alleged irregularities in the Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) recruitment examination

ai.background_note: The protests are part of ongoing demands for transparency in J&K's recruitment processes, linked to the broader context of political tensions in the region.
